verdict.rationale: Aider's own docs cover the lint and test parts of this story. It lints every file it edits, runs your test suite via /test or --auto-test, and voice mode explicitly mentions requesting test cases. Nothing in the evidence shows it resolving merge conflicts or updating dependencies; the generic /git and /run commands are adjacent tools, not those capabilities. missing for 10: merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, explicit documentation that it auto-fixes lint/test failures, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: By default, aider will lint any files which it edits.
You can configure aider to run your test suite after each time the AI edits your code using the --test-cmd <test-command> and --auto-test switch.
Request new features, test cases or bug fixes using your voice and let aider do the work of editing the files in your local git repo.
